title: LLM Evaluation and Testing Framework
summary: This module provides a comprehensive framework for evaluating Language Model (LLM) outputs and agent trajectories, including various evaluators, LangSmith integration for dataset-based testing, and base classes for integration and unit tests of chat models and vector stores.

nodes.label: String Evaluator Interface
nodes.title: StringEvaluator
nodes.description: Abstract base class for evaluating string predictions against inputs and/or reference labels.

nodes.label: Pairwise String Evaluator Interface
nodes.title: PairwiseStringEvaluator
nodes.description: Abstract base class for comparing the output of two models or two outputs of the same model.

nodes.label: Agent Trajectory Evaluator Interface
nodes.title: AgentTrajectoryEvaluator
nodes.description: Abstract base class for evaluating the sequence of actions taken by an agent.

nodes.label: Evaluate Agent Trajectories
nodes.title: TrajectoryEvalChain
nodes.description: Evaluates ReAct-style agents by reasoning about the sequence of actions taken and their outcomes using an LLM.

nodes.label: Compare Labeled String Outputs
nodes.title: LabeledPairwiseStringEvalChain
nodes.description: Compares two string outputs (e.g., from two models) with labeled preferences, requiring a reference.

nodes.label: Evaluate Against Labeled Criteria
nodes.title: LabeledCriteriaEvalChain
nodes.description: Evaluates model outputs against specified criteria, requiring a reference for correctness.

nodes.label: Check JSON Validity
nodes.title: JsonValidityEvaluator
nodes.description: Evaluates whether a given string prediction is valid JSON, returning a score and reasoning if invalid.

nodes.label: Check JSON Equality
nodes.title: JsonEqualityEvaluator
nodes.description: Evaluates whether a prediction is equal to a reference after parsing both as JSON.

nodes.label: Validate JSON against Schema
nodes.title: JsonSchemaEvaluator
nodes.description: Validates a JSON prediction against a provided JSON schema, indicating conformance.

nodes.label: QA Evaluation with Chain-of-Thought
nodes.title: CotQAEvalChain
nodes.description: LLM Chain for evaluating Question Answering (QA) using chain of thought reasoning.

nodes.label: Evaluate Question Answering
nodes.title: QAEvalChain
nodes.description: LLM Chain for evaluating question answering tasks, requiring an input question and a reference answer.

nodes.label: Score String Output with Labels
nodes.title: LabeledScoreStringEvalChain
nodes.description: Scores model outputs on a numerical scale (e.g., 1-10) against criteria, requiring a reference.

nodes.label: Load Evaluator Instances
nodes.title: load_evaluators
nodes.description: Utility function to load multiple evaluator instances based on their types and configuration.

nodes.label: Manage Dataset Evaluation Runs
nodes.title: _DatasetRunContainer
nodes.description: Manages the state and execution of evaluation runs on a dataset, collecting metrics and feedback for LangSmith.

nodes.label: Run Sync Evaluation on Dataset
nodes.title: run_on_dataset
nodes.description: Synchronously runs a language model or chain on a dataset, performs evaluation, and logs traces to LangSmith.

nodes.label: Run Async Evaluation on Dataset
nodes.title: arun_on_dataset
nodes.description: Asynchronously runs a language model or chain on a dataset, performs evaluation, and logs traces to LangSmith.

nodes.label: Asynchronously Run LLM or Chain
nodes.title: _arun_llm_or_chain
nodes.description: Asynchronously executes a language model or chain for a single example within a dataset evaluation context.

nodes.label: Adapt String Evaluator for Runs
nodes.title: StringRunEvaluatorChain
nodes.description: Adapts a StringEvaluator to evaluate LangSmith Run objects, mapping run data to string inputs for evaluation.

nodes.label: Labeled Score String Config
nodes.title: LabeledScoreString
nodes.description: Configuration for a labeled score string evaluator within the LangSmith evaluation framework.

nodes.label: Labeled Criteria Config
nodes.title: LabeledCriteria
nodes.description: Configuration for a labeled (with references) criteria evaluator within the LangSmith evaluation framework.

nodes.label: Embedding Distance Config
nodes.title: EmbeddingDistance
nodes.description: Configuration for an embedding distance evaluator, specifying embeddings and distance metric for LangSmith.

nodes.label: String Distance Config
nodes.title: StringDistance
nodes.description: Configuration for a string distance evaluator, specifying the metric and normalization for LangSmith.

nodes.label: QA Evaluator Config
nodes.title: QA
nodes.description: Configuration for a Question Answering (QA) evaluator, including prompt and LLM for LangSmith.

nodes.label: Context QA Evaluator Config
nodes.title: ContextQA
nodes.description: Configuration for a context-based QA evaluator, including prompt and LLM for LangSmith.

nodes.label: CoT QA Evaluator Config
nodes.title: CoTQA
nodes.description: Configuration for a Chain-of-Thought QA evaluator, including prompt and LLM for LangSmith.

nodes.label: JSON Validity Evaluator Config
nodes.title: JsonValidity
nodes.description: Configuration for a JSON validity evaluator within the LangSmith evaluation framework.

nodes.label: Exact Match Evaluator Config
nodes.title: ExactMatch
nodes.description: Configuration for an exact match string evaluator, with options for case, punctuation, and number ignoring.

nodes.label: Regex Match Evaluator Config
nodes.title: RegexMatch
nodes.description: Configuration for a regex match string evaluator, allowing specification of regex flags.

nodes.label: LangSmith CI Context
nodes.title: _langsmith_ci_context
nodes.description: Provides a context manager to apply LangSmith tags and metadata to traces during Continuous Integration (CI).

nodes.label: Base VCR Configuration
nodes.title: _base_vcr_config
nodes.description: Returns a base VCR (cassette library for HTTP interactions) configuration dictionary for integration tests.

nodes.label: Chat Model Integration Tests
nodes.title: ChatModelIntegrationTests
nodes.description: Base class for integration tests of chat models, providing common test methods and configuration properties for various model features.

nodes.label: Vector Store Integration Tests
nodes.title: VectorStoreIntegrationTests
nodes.description: Base class for integration tests of vector stores, providing common test methods for adding, deleting, and searching documents.

nodes.label: Chat Model Unit Tests
nodes.title: ChatModelUnitTests
nodes.description: Base class for unit tests of chat models, covering initialization, serialization, and standard parameter handling.

nodes.label: Test Anthropic Inputs
nodes.title: test_anthropic_inputs
nodes.description: Tests if a chat model can process Anthropic-style message histories, including tool use and tool result content blocks.

nodes.label: Test Image Tool Messages
nodes.title: test_image_tool_message
nodes.description: Tests if a chat model can process ToolMessage objects containing image inputs in various formats (base64, URL).

nodes.label: Test PDF Tool Messages
nodes.title: test_pdf_tool_message
nodes.description: Tests if a chat model can process ToolMessage objects containing PDF inputs (base64 encoded).

nodes.label: Test Model Serialization/Deserialization
nodes.title: test_serdes
nodes.description: Tests the serialization and deserialization capabilities of chat models, ensuring proper state preservation.

nodes.label: Base Language Model
nodes.title: BaseLanguageModel
nodes.description: Abstract base class for all language models, defining common interfaces.

nodes.label: LLM Chain
nodes.title: LLMChain
nodes.description: A chain that runs an LLM on a given prompt.

nodes.label: Base Tool
nodes.title: BaseTool
nodes.description: Abstract base class for tools that agents can use.

nodes.label: Prompt Template
nodes.title: PromptTemplate
nodes.description: A template for constructing prompts to language models.

nodes.label: Base Output Parser
nodes.title: BaseOutputParser
nodes.description: Abstract base class for parsing the output of language models.

nodes.label: LangSmith Client
nodes.title: Client
nodes.description: Client for interacting with the LangSmith platform for logging and tracing.

nodes.label: LangSmith Run
nodes.title: Run
nodes.description: Represents a single execution trace or step within LangSmith.

nodes.label: LangSmith Example
nodes.title: Example
nodes.description: Represents a single input/output pair in a LangSmith dataset.

nodes.label: Runnable Configuration
nodes.title: RunnableConfig
nodes.description: Configuration options for LangChain Runnables, including callbacks and tags.

nodes.label: LangSmith Evaluation Result
nodes.title: EvaluationResult
nodes.description: Represents the outcome of an evaluation in LangSmith, including score, reasoning, and metadata.

nodes.label: Vector Store
nodes.title: VectorStore
nodes.description: Abstract base class for vector databases, defining methods for document storage and retrieval.

nodes.label: Document
nodes.title: Document
nodes.description: A piece of text and associated metadata, typically used in retrieval systems.

nodes.label: Embeddings
nodes.title: Embeddings
nodes.description: Abstract base class for text embedding models.

nodes.label: Base Chat Model
nodes.title: BaseChatModel
nodes.description: Abstract base class for chat-oriented language models.

nodes.label: AI Message
nodes.title: AIMessage
nodes.description: A message from an AI assistant in a conversation.

nodes.label: Tool Message
nodes.title: ToolMessage
nodes.description: A message representing the output of a tool call.

nodes.label: Human Message
nodes.title: HumanMessage
nodes.description: A message from a human user in a conversation.

nodes.label: System Message
nodes.title: SystemMessage
nodes.description: A message providing context or instructions to the AI system.

nodes.label: Pytest Snapshot Assertion
nodes.title: SnapshotAssertion
nodes.description: A pytest fixture for asserting that a value matches a stored snapshot.

nodes.label: JSON Schema Library
nodes.title: jsonschema
nodes.description: External library for validating JSON data against a JSON schema.

groups.label: Evaluation Interfaces
groups.title: Evaluation Interfaces
groups.description: Abstract base classes defining common interfaces for different types of evaluators.

groups.label: LLM-based Evaluators
groups.title: LLM-based Evaluators
groups.description: Evaluator chains that leverage Language Models for their core evaluation logic.

groups.label: Parsing & Schema Evaluators
groups.title: Parsing & Schema Evaluators
groups.description: Evaluators focused on validating the structural integrity and format of model outputs.

groups.label: LangSmith Evaluation Framework
groups.title: LangSmith Evaluation Framework
groups.description: Components for integrating and orchestrating evaluation processes with the LangSmith platform, including dataset management and configuration.

groups.label: Testing Utilities
groups.title: Testing Utilities
groups.description: General utility functions and helpers for setting up and running tests and evaluations.

groups.label: Integration Test Suites
groups.title: Integration Test Suites
groups.description: Base classes and specific tests for verifying the end-to-end functionality and interactions of LangChain components like chat models and vector stores.

groups.label: Unit Test Suites
groups.title: Unit Test Suites
groups.description: Base classes and specific tests for verifying individual components of LangChain, such as chat model initialization and serialization.
